connector.name: Influship
connector.registryDescription: Find and analyze influencers with creator search, lookalikes, profiles, posts, and transcripts.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.influship.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the influship account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
